verdict.rationale: Slate is an AI coding agent that sends user code and prompts to model providers. A training opt-out is therefore a fair privacy question for this kind of product. The evidence pack has no documented training opt-out, zero-retention policy, or data-use control. Permission settings govern which agent actions need approval, not data use, so they are an adjacent control and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
